The word uses only sigma_1 and sigma_2, which generate B_3; the figure-eight knot is the closure of (sigma_1 sigma_2^{-1})^2 in B_3. Component count confirms it: the permutation is ((12)(23))^2 = a 3-cycle, one cycle, so the closure is a KNOT.
